notes.title: Announcing my New Game: The Boba Teashop
notes.content:
Hey guys,

First of all, I would like to thank all who bought and supported my first Steam game "Home_0". Your support is what keep me going in making more games.

As seen in the title, I have been developing a brand new horror game for the past few months. May I present to you:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461920/The_Boba_Teashop/][b]The Boba Teashop[/b][/url]. 

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461920/The_Boba_Teashop/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106031/4e1951f231b0593070e3a97ca1b3b5f514efd5a4.png[/img][/url]

A cozy horror game where you manage a boba teashop, make boba milk tea and serve customer.

I will be releasing a demo soon, if you are interested. Be sure to wishlist "The Boba Teashop" to get notified once the demo or the full game is released.

Head on over to the Steam page with the link below:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461920/The_Boba_Teashop/

notes.title: Major Bug fix on 12 Dec 2024
notes.content: Fixed a bug where players are unable load the next day when going to sleep or exit the house in Normal mode

notes.title: EASY MODE Now Available!
notes.content:
"EASY MODE" for Home_0 is now available. With the Easy Mode, difficult anomalies are reduced and some "fixed events" are adjusted to make it more easier to differentiate anomalies and reality.

If you just want to experience the story of Home_0, this mode may be suited for you. However, playing with this mode will disable achievements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106031/e0bbe699836d6dba93f26f93f00d1497af581278.png[/img]

notes.title: HOME_0 IS NOW OFFICIALLY RELEASED
notes.content:
After working on Home_0 for about 4 months, I am proud to announce that HOME_0 is now officially released.

I would like to thank all the fans who played the demo and leave some encouraging message for me to keep making the game.

As an indie game developer, reviews are extremely important. And it would help tremendously if you could leave a review whether to you like or dislike the game.

Once again, I hope you enjoy the game and I wish to keep making subsequent horror games for years to come.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106031/0bba4e99ba0a4a00d16dd239b94159c8ed4ad643.png[/img]

notes.title: Announcement for Release Date of Home_0
notes.content:
Hello all,

After months of development time, we are pleased to announce that [b]Home_0[/b] release date will be set on the [b]7th November 2024[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45106031/671d1850d436fcce680d1a0815df4e6be6374bf6.png[/img]

A newer version of Home_0 Demo is also live now. You can download the new update now which should reflects the final version of the game better.

notes.title: The Demo for Home_0 is now released
notes.content:
The demo for my new horror game "HOME_0" is finally available for download on steam.

This demo features 3 days out of the 10 days from the full game, where you can test out the features and performance of the game.

You can go to the main page and click on the download button now:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3066510/Home_0/][img]https://i.imgur.com/BahAQ0a.png[/img][/url]


Please keep in mind that this demo is very short. You can probably beat it around 5 to 10 minutes.

Furthermore, this demo is currently in an alpha state and it has not been extensively tested yet. If you encounter any bugs or need to give me some feedbacks on the game, feel free to leave a comment in this discussion post below.

Your help is greatly appreciated in improving "HOME_0" full release.

Thank you in advance for playing.
